changelog:
Add optional per-user playback-performance profiles for capture FPS, frame resolution, video fit, deinterlacing, sampling, and temporal color smoothing
Leave performance profile fields blank to inherit the global capture and sampling settings
Capture effective per-user performance settings at playback startup for a consistent session pipeline
Report the active per-user performance profile in sanitized runtime status and the configuration page
Add regression coverage for performance override inheritance, validation, persistence, runtime resolution, and status/API wiring
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
